native_matrix_complete_scope: ONLY FiniteAlphaObservedProfile814; not general release, hardware/feature/size compatibility or completion of the broader project objective

observed_profile.description: Native-shadow experimental alpha on the exact recorded nonboot data-volume fixture

operations.scope: Actual public normal conversion, HND, 2558 bindings; independent original 811 streams/1534 baseline objects/1024 additional directory paths.
513 new mutation files, normal reboot without restore, original streams and extra directories checked again; no physical allocation-reuse claim.
Public resume after normal restart from the exact independently saved 814 diagnostic AP origin; original content independently checked.
Separate public rollback after restart from the same original AP origin; restore-required selected bytes, original logical contents and paths checked; unused free bytes not restored.
Already-online operational HND label/mount reconciliation; no raw replay or stale selected-data comparison; mutation files preserved.
Expected ERROR32/nonzero exit while an actual read-only FileShare.None journal handle remained held through the actual native terminal.
One second-slot checksum byte corrupted; expected pre-prompt checksum refusal; original 131072 control bytes restored in place with original file identity. No measured native source-write counter.
Separate post-restart cancellation of authenticated Frozen preparation with no J/AP publication; native structured zero-payload-write result and independent NTFS content/path verification.

Intentional diagnostic nonzero exit after one real 4096-byte metadata write, flush/readback, durable AP and separately authenticated remaining OLD primary; not copied user-payload interruption or physical power loss.
Preparation-only actual reserve-admission refusal before journal/AP; source remained excluded. No actual ENOSPC/write/flush failure claimed.

binaries.name: lab-observe-resource-recovery
binaries.scope: Original three-tool build provenance only. This binary was not run for this finite profile; independent checks used separately pinned historical content-observation tools.

evidence_resolution: Evidence paths identify original repository receipts. The package file manifest maps source_path and SHA-256 to included receipt filenames; all pointers remain observational.
limitations: Only the named 52 GiB partition with about 9.9 GB logical fixture data was observed; this is not full-volume, arbitrary-size or maximum-NTFS-compatibility qualification.

512-byte logical/4096-byte physical sectors, NTFS 64 KiB and ReFS 4 KiB, the exact Windows build and basic nonboot dedicated-disk routing are the observed geometry/profile. Other configurations require their own qualification.
Source data partitions sharing the running Windows physical disk remain unsupported by the current conversion writer; the separate read-only partition experiment does not grant writer authority.
The managed-shadow backend uses VHDX and retains its approximately 64 TB native format ceiling and staging overhead. There is no alternate scratch provider; 1000 TB conversion is unsupported.
Boot/system volumes, broader feature/build/storage compatibility and arbitrary hardware/scale are not qualified by this matrix.

Only a controlled first-flushed metadata-write interruption followed by normal restart was exercised. Copied user-payload interruption, physical power loss, active write/flush/readback errors, actual ENOSPC and missing/conflicting valid guard-copy combinations are not qualified.

Independent checks cover the reported original stream contents, baseline path/type/length objects and additional directory paths; they are not a complete original ACL/SACL/timestamp audit or a no-extra-objects proof.
Native-shadow scratch use remains dependent on actual layout, relocation/materialization and recovery storage. Retained allocation snapshots are not peak scratch/RAM or physical-I/O measurements.
Recorded timings are uncontrolled observations on this fixture, not guaranteed conversion times or a benchmark across hardware and volume sizes.
HND and ABT close old raw replay. Qualification receipts and this sidecar grant no source admission, current-device identity, recovery authority or permission to replay an old journal.
The embedded qualification registry and frozen executable bytes were not rebuilt; this external sidecar records only the listed finite alpha observations.
